answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for shadow work, the strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform’s _Encounters with the Shadow_**, **Awake Academy’s _Embracing The Shadow_**, and **Catherine Liggett’s _Shadow Work 101_** because they are explicitly framed as structured shadow-work trainings rather than generic self-help content.[8][17][6]

For **spiritual practice** specifically, the most relevant options are **Udemy’s _Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self_** and **Udemy’s _Shadow Work Course and Workbook_**, since both explicitly connect shadow work with spiritual transformation and include practices such as meditations and prayers.[3][11]

Here’s a practical shortlist based on what your results show:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** | Jungian depth work | Described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of Jung Platform’s Jungian psychology series.[8] |
| **Embracing The Shadow** | Guided transformative practice | Marketed as a course with strong personal transformation focus and praised by a reviewer for changing relationships.[17] |
| **Shadow Work 101** | Live, structured learning | A **5-week live online course via Zoom**, which suggests more direct guidance and accountability.[6] |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** | Shadow work plus spirituality | Explicitly mentions spiritual awakening alongside healing and integration.[3] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** | Practical exercises | Includes lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices for introspective and spiritual transformation.[11] |
| **Shadow Mastery Diploma Course** | More formal self-development track | Described as a reflective journey inspired by Jungian psychology and modern personal development.[5] |

A few notes on choosing:
- If you want the **most psychologically grounded** option, start with **Jung Platform**.[8]
- If you want **live support and accountability**, choose **Shadow Work 101**.[6]
- If you want a **more spiritual, practice-heavy** course, the **Udemy** options look the most aligned with that goal.[3][11]
- If you want a **broader personal-development framing**, **Shadow Mastery** and **Awake Academy** may fit better.[5][17]

If you want, I can also narrow these down into **best beginner course, best advanced course, and best spiritual/meditative course**.
